g.text: Workflow 1: Inventory Counting & Multi-Modal Input (Keypad / BLE / Voice)
Enter numeric value via touch buttons
base unit (kg, g, piece), and previous count
Display count modal with virtual numeric keypad
Add preset increment to current keypad value
Populate input field with stabilized weight
Normalize phonetic Arabic text (strip Tashkeel, unify Alef/Yaa)
Convert Arabic word numbers to digits
Execute Levenshtein fuzzy match to resolve product
Convert entered quantity to canonical base unit
Push previous item state to Undo Stack
Update reactive item card badge in UI
Pop top item descriptor from Undo Stack
Revert count to previous recorded value
Recalculate variance and update status badge
Display toast: "تم التراجع عن الجرد بنجاح"
Advance focus to next catalog item in category
Scan for BLE devices with Weight Service 0x181D
Establish GATT connection and enable notifications
Place physical product on scale pan
Parse Byte 0 flags (unit SI vs Imperial)
and extract 16-bit weight with resolution factor
Retain mutation in pending local queue
Persist reverted state locally and sync to cloud
